claims: A criminal defense attorney requires a bachelor's degree.
A criminal defense attorney requires a Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree from an accredited law school.
A criminal defense attorney requires passing the state bar exam.
Hourly rates for less experienced criminal defense attorneys in smaller markets range from $150–$250.
Hourly rates for experienced criminal defense specialists are $400–$700+ per hour.
Experts recommend hiring a specialized criminal defense attorney, particularly a former prosecutor who knows how cases are built, rather than a general practitioner.
